Services

What the station does

From the station’s sign, its Facebook page and its Google reviews.

MOT test

The annual technical inspection of your vehicle. The sign on the building says: car inspections.

Imported cars

One customer came with a left-hand drive car from Europe and got the paperwork done and advice on registering it. Another writes that the SVA test can be passed here.

Headlight adjustment

One customer stopped by only to have the headlights adjusted, and it was done quickly.

Appointments

Customers recommend booking ahead. One called at the last minute and still got an appointment the same day.

Quick

An inspection station in Paphos

MOT D.G Auto Security works at Andrea Vlami 4 in Paphos, behind three red doors with the letters M, O and T. Its sign promises the best workshop with the most modern equipment, and 56 of its 58 Google reviews give five stars. One customer writes that everyone speaks English, and another review is pleasantly surprised by French at the reception.

What customers say

Three of 58 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“Had an amazing experience with this MOT service in Cyprus. I came with a European left-hand drive car and everything was done in about 30 minutes. The staff were very friendly and professional, gave helpful advice about the car, completed all paperwork, and even guided me on how to register the car. The price is low for such high-quality service. The place is clean, organised, everyone speaks English, and the service is truly 5-star. I will definitely return for my next MOT.”

Google review
“Second time have M.O.T. here - great service, thorough full check. Professional, efficient and highly recommended.”

Google review
